records.source_title: Brembo Annual Report 2025
records.excerpt: Brembo’s revenue from contracts with customers amounted to €3,702,699 thousand in 2025, down 3.6% compared to €3,840,643 thousand in 2024.
records.population: Brembo Group
records.does_not_establish: Total revenue says nothing about how much of it comes from individual buyers rather than vehicle manufacturers.

records.source_title: Brembo Annual Report 2025
records.excerpt: The car applications sector, which accounted for 73.5% of the Group’s sales, closed 2025 with a 5.2% decrease compared to the previous year. Applications for commercial vehicles closed at -10.5%, motorcycle applications at -10.6% and racing applications at +52.9%.
records.population: Brembo Group sales by vehicle application
records.does_not_establish: The split is by vehicle type, not by customer type, so it does not show the aftermarket or consumer share of sales.

records.source_title: Brembo Annual Report 2025
records.excerpt: Brembo operates in both the original equipment market and the aftermarket. Brembo’s range of products for car and commercial vehicle applications includes brake discs, brake calipers, the side-wheel module and, increasingly often, the complete braking system, including integrated engineering services.
records.population: Brembo customers in original equipment and aftermarket
records.does_not_establish: It does not give the size of the aftermarket business or what share of it reaches end users rather than trade buyers.

records.source_title: Brembo Annual Report 2025
records.excerpt: The main buyers include automotive and two-wheeler manufacturers. Additionally, Brembo sells its products to ITG, distributors, spare parts dealers, mechanics, and tuners for aftermarket activities and car and motorcycle upgrades. The products are also available through web channels, further expanding market reach.
records.population: Brembo buyers and sales channels
records.does_not_establish: It lists channels but gives no revenue by channel and does not say whether the web channels are Brembo's own or resellers'.

records.source_title: Brembo Annual Report 2025
records.excerpt: The risk of presence of counterfeited products in the Aftermarket (especially in the Far East) is also managed by the Legal and Corporate Affair GCF with the support of other GCFs by applying multiple approaches and actions (e.g., online and local investigations, QR code, etc.).
records.population: Brembo aftermarket products and their buyers
records.does_not_establish: It does not quantify how many counterfeits circulate or how much sales they displace.

records.source_title: Big brake kit - Brembo UPGRADE GT kit for car
records.excerpt: Designed and tested specifically for track day enthusiasts and for drivers who demand maximum performance from their vehicle, these systems offer exceptional performance along with a truly sporty look.
records.population: Car owners and track day enthusiasts buying upgrade brake kits
records.does_not_establish: It does not show how many kits are sold, at what price, or whether buyers come through Brembo directly or through resellers.

records.source_title: Upgrade Line Calipers - Brembo Parts
records.excerpt: Their compact and lightweight design helps reduce the unsprung weight, significantly improving vehicle dynamics. Stability, endurance and consistency: every detail is designed for motorbike enthusiasts seeking uncompromising performance.
records.population: Motorcycle riders buying aftermarket upgrade calipers
records.does_not_establish: It is product positioning and gives no evidence of sales volume or rider demand.

records.source_title: Brembo GR-PRO braking system - Brembo Parts
records.excerpt: The new BREMBO GR-PRO brings to the MTB world the systemic approach and motorsport expertise that Brembo has perfected over decades. Designed for the most demanding riders, BREMBO GR-PRO is made for environments where gravity pushes every component to its limit: long descents, high speeds, extreme temperatures.
records.population: Mountain bike riders, especially gravity and downhill riders
records.does_not_establish: It does not say how many kits have sold or whether the product is profitable.

records.source_title: Brembo Expert, why take part - Brembo Parts
records.excerpt: The Brembo Expert workshop network, that as of today exceeds the one thousand mark in the national and international territory, is capable of offering a professional and cutting edge service for every kind of vehicle.
records.population: Independent workshops in the Brembo Expert network and the drivers they serve
records.does_not_establish: It does not show how many drivers use these workshops or whether the network could carry a new consumer offer.

records.source_title: Brembo Group at EICMA 2026 Between Innovation, Performance and Lifestyle
records.excerpt: The Brembo Lifestyle Collection also makes its debut at EICMA 2026, bringing the brand’s identity beyond the world of braking systems and translating its distinctive codes into a lifestyle offering. Unveiled for the first time at EICMA, the collection will initially be available at the Brembo pop-up store during the event and on the official Brembo Collections e-commerce platform, from November 3.
records.population: Individual buyers of branded apparel and accessories
records.does_not_establish: It announces a launch and gives no sales results or evidence of demand for the collection.

records.source_title: Brembo Group at EICMA 2026 Between Innovation, Performance and Lifestyle
records.excerpt: The new XTRA Signature disc also makes its debut, developed for urban and everyday use. Finally, the offer extends to the off-road segment with the first Brembo braking solutions dedicated to Side-by-Side Vehicles (SSVs).
records.population: Motorcycle and side-by-side vehicle owners in the aftermarket
records.does_not_establish: It names new products but gives no evidence of how many buyers want them.

records.source_title: Why braking can be the ultimate upgrade (sponsored article by Brembo), CAT Magazine
records.excerpt: The Upgrade braking systems solutions are designed specifically for wholesalers and distributors to meet this demand.
records.population: Car enthusiasts and the wholesalers and distributors that supply them
records.does_not_establish: It is Brembo's own sponsored text and gives no figures on enthusiast numbers or upgrade sales.

records.source_title: ECE Regulation 90 - Wikipedia
records.excerpt: Type-approval to R90 is required for all replacement brake linings throughout the European Union and in non-European countries that have adopted ECE Regulations.
records.geography: European Union and other countries applying ECE Regulations
records.population: Makers and sellers of replacement brake linings
records.does_not_establish: It covers replacement linings only and does not say how upgrade kits or bicycle brakes are regulated.

records.source_title: Resilient despite headwinds: bicycle industry stable in 2025 - ZIV
records.excerpt: E-bikes held a 52.7 percent share of the market and bicycles a 47.3 percent share. Sales remained high nonetheless, with around 2 million e-bikes sold.
records.population: Bicycle and e-bike buyers in Germany
records.does_not_establish: It does not show how many e-bike buyers would pay for premium or branded brakes.

records.source_title: Resilient despite headwinds: bicycle industry stable in 2025 - ZIV
records.excerpt: Turnover from the sale of bicycles and e-bikes fell 7.7 percent to 5.85 billion euros – a considerably smaller decline than in the previous year. A total of 3.8 million units were sold in 2025 – down 3.9 percent compared to 2024.
records.population: Bicycle and e-bike buyers in Germany
records.does_not_establish: It covers complete bikes, not aftermarket components, so it does not measure demand for upgrade brakes.

records.source_title: Registrations of motorcycles and mopeds in key European markets during the year 2025 - ACEM
records.excerpt: New motorcycle registrations in five of the largest European markets (i.e. France, Germany, Italy, Spain and the UK) reached 1.002.848 units during 2025. This represents a variation of approximately -12,9 % compared to the same period in 2024 (1.150.852 units).
records.geography: France, Germany, Italy, Spain and the United Kingdom
records.population: Buyers of new motorcycles
records.does_not_establish: New registrations do not measure aftermarket spending by riders of motorcycles already on the road.

records.source_title: Shimano's uneven recovery: Currency losses wipe out 3% sales growth in 2025 - Velora
records.excerpt: European retail sales remained strong but channel stock is still "somewhat high." In China, demand for high-end road bikes showed "signs of easing," with retail sales described as "lackluster" and inventories elevated.
records.population: Bicycle component buyers served by Shimano
records.does_not_establish: Shimano's position in mainstream bicycle components does not show how a newcomer in premium bicycle brakes would fare.

records.source_title: About EBC Brakes
records.excerpt: With a worldwide work force of over 400 people, EBC Brakes is an independently owned and managed leader in the brake market, proud of its customers, its products, its success and its people. EBC Brakes produce the largest range of brake pads and brake discs in the world, with over 60,000 part numbers for every type of moving vehicle.
records.population: Buyers of aftermarket brake pads and discs
records.does_not_establish: It is a competitor's self-description and gives no sales figures or split between trade and individual buyers.

records.source_title: Brembo GR-PRO review - BikeRadar
records.excerpt: The brakes bring 50 years of motorsport heritage, a little Italian flare, buckets of power and market-leading adjustability to mountain biking, but they come at a price (€750 for the kit) that’s going to be tricky to justify.
records.population: Mountain bike riders
records.does_not_establish: One reviewer's test does not show how many riders will buy at that price.

records.source_title: Counterfeit Brembo caliper - Access Norton Motorcycle Forums
records.excerpt: I ordered a 4 piston Brembo caliper and what I got is what I'm sure is a counterfeit. I would have ordered from Mat but he was out of them. Though the picture on ebay was the real thing what I got was a garish gold color with pink brake pads.
records.population: A motorcycle owner buying a Brembo caliper online
records.does_not_establish: A single forum post does not show how common counterfeits are among online purchases.

records.source_title: Beware Fake Brembo Brake Covers - Torque News
records.excerpt: According to Brembo “The Aichi prefectural police in the Chubu region of Japan have arrested eight people for selling 87 plastic covers originating from China but marked with the Brembo logo.”
records.population: Car owners buying Brembo-branded cosmetic caliper covers
records.does_not_establish: It shows that branded look-alike accessories were sold, not how large or lasting demand for Brembo-branded accessories is.

records.source_title: SEMA Market Research: Off-Road Culture Continues to Drive Consumer Spending - SEMA
records.excerpt: Overall, the performance and accessory aftermarket continues to show strong results, as roughly one-fourth of drivers purchased products within the industry to personalize their vehicles last year. In 2025, pickup and SUV modifications, the two biggest segments for off-road parts, made up 43% of the entire $52.92 billion accessory and performance parts market.
records.population: Drivers who buy accessories and performance parts
records.does_not_establish: It covers all accessory and performance parts and does not give spending on brakes specifically.
